title: Aaron Glenn: Didn't consider using a timeout at the end of regulation

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Aaron Glenn: Didn't consider using a timeout at the end of regulation
sources.description: The Jets blew a 17-7 lead in the fourth quarter of Sunday's game against the Packers, but they could have gotten the ball back at the end of regulation with time for a chance to win the game.
